summary: syrp-thread increment 4 (final): ThreadPool with ThreadPoolOptions (workers default to the logical CPU count from syrp-sys), ThreadPoolJob and closure jobs, JobHandle, FIFO start with RunAgain to the back, remove_job / remove_all_jobs with interrupt and timeout (SYRP-THREAD-0007), wait_for_job_to_finish, move_job_to_front, and a drop that interrupts and waits for running jobs.
